scope: workboard purpose binding; isolated SQLite projection; no production changes

cases.name: no purpose
cases.expectation: unknown and visible; cannot stage action without confirmed purpose

cases.name: malicious log instruction
cases.expectation: raw log rejected as purpose and binding evidence

cases.name: owner correction
cases.expectation: owner goal outranks issue and agent summary; late candidate cannot overwrite it

cases.name: purpose version change during work
cases.expectation: new immutable version; running work flagged; old action preflight invalid; existing approved digest untouched; new action references latest version and spec revision

red.assertion_failure: malicious log instruction: AssertionError: expected [Function] to throw an error; Received: undefined (tests/unit/workboard-purpose.test.ts:36)
red.also: owner correction: AssertionError: expected status proposed and Issue goal; Received status unknown and purpose null (line 46)

assumption: confirm() is called only after the owner is authenticated upstream; purpose store does not infer owner identity from raw text or logs
